subject: Important Updates regarding your upcoming flight
body: Dear valued customer, We would like to inform you about some important updates regarding your upcoming flight. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there have been changes to the departure time. Please review the new details in the attached document. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our airline. Regards, Airline Customer Service Team
